# ErlangTerm.jl

Unmodified ETF transport from [ErlangTerm.jl](https://github.com/helgee/ErlangTerm.jl),
version 0.1.1, commit `9b3f18a0dc8e8fafda6ac90d84660b2ea5efe6e6`.
Its MIT license is included. The worker loads this copy directly, so the bridge
needs no registry, package installation or precompiled Julia environment.
